results: A fresh Edge context reopened the actual local app; real Skill files and initial import were visible
Workspace search returned real file/line results and collapsed again
Typing revealed controls; discard confirmation could be cancelled and confirmed
Actual edited bytes saved and promoted in the private registry with a new visible commit
Historical revision shows the selected-file comparison without raw diff headers
scope: Actual local Skill app, browser, registry and operation service; no model/provider/GitHub acceptance
authentication_limit: The private app uses single-user auto-login. Reopening with private browser state established app access, not cookie identity continuity, expired-login handling or profile restoration.
